artworks.title: Edward, Lord Lyttelton of Mounslow
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man with long hair and a mustache, looking forward. He is wearing a formal garment with a wide lace collar and a richly decorated robe featuring a coat of arms. The background is plain, with a parchment-like texture. Below the portrait is a line of text identifying the man as "Honoratiss Ds Edwardus Litleton Mag: Sigil: Ang: Custos: etc.," along with the names "Sould by P. Stent" and "W. M. sculpsit."

artworks.title: Henry Cary, Earl of Monmouth
artworks.description: The sculpture is a bust of a man identified as Henricus Dom. Cary, Baro de Leppington, Com. de Monmouth. The bust depicts the man with wavy, shoulder-length hair, a mustache, and a part of a goatee, facing to the left. The sculpture appears to be made of stone or marble, indicated by its detailed texture and the engraving style of the artwork. The bust is mounted on an ornate pedestal that features inscriptions, and it stands against a backdrop of stylized horizontal lines. In the background, there is a serene landscaped setting with trees and a small church, all presented in a monochrome, detailed engraving style that enhances the classic and formal appearance of the portrait.

artworks.title: Henry Cary
artworks.description: The image displays a bust of a man's upper body in profile, facing left. The man has distinct facial features with a nose, cheekbones, beard, and mustache. His hair is wavy, falling to his neck. The bust is on a pedestal with an inscription. The base of the bust is ornate. The background has engraved lines and a landscape with a church steeple and trees.

artworks.title: Henry Cary, Earl of Monmouth
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man in profile view. The man has long wavy hair, a mustache, and a goatee. The bust is placed on a detailed pedestal with inscriptions and additional text. In the background, there are rolling hills with trees and a small building on the right side.

artworks.title: John Ogilby
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of Johannes Ogilvius, depicted from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a long, prominent nose, full lips, and deep-set eyes. His hair is long and wavy, reaching his shoulders. Ogilvius wears a dark, collared robe with horizontal lines, and he is holding a medallion or coin in his right hand with a profile image. There is no visible jewelry. The background has intricate line work, with the portrait set within an oval frame. Below the oval is a curtain-like design with the engraving's title, "JOHANNES OGILVIUS," the artist's name, "Guil: Marshall fecit," and the year "1649" at the bottom.

artworks.title: John Parkinson, Apothecary and Herbalist to James I
artworks.description: The image shows an oval-framed portrait of a man's upper body. The man faces forward with a slightly turned head, revealing his facial features including a long beard, mustache, and expressive eyes. He wears a cap and an intricately detailed garment with a large ruff collar. He holds a blooming flower in his right hand. The background is plain, drawing attention to the figure within the ornate border.

artworks.title: William Perkins, Preacher
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a bearded man shown from the waist up. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man's facial features include a prominent forehead, deeply set eyes, full eyebrows, and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair appears to be closely cropped. He is wearing a traditional outfit consisting of a jacket with a ruffed collar. His hand is visible holding a pen or quill near the bottom center of the image. The background consists of a textured rectangular frame with diagonal lines creating a shaded effect. Below the portrait, there is a text panel mentioning the name "William Perkins" and a descriptive text about him.

artworks.title: John Quarles, Poet
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a person's upper body. The individual faces forward with a slightly tilted head. They have a long face, prominent nose, slightly parted lips, and eyes looking ahead. The person has long, wavy hair reaching their shoulders and wears formal attire with a dark, buttoned jacket and a light collar with a bow tie or decorative element. They hold a paper in their right hand against their chest. The background features a decorative oval frame with a crest and floral or leafy elements. Below the portrait is a block of text providing context or inscription.

artworks.title: John Quarles
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter length portrait of a person seated, facing slightly to the left with their left arm resting on a surface, holding a book. The individual has high cheekbones, a long nose, and a neutral expression. They have long, wavy hair past the shoulders and wear a dark jacket with button details, a light-colored collar, a decorative collar, and a lace cuff. They wear a chain with a pendant. The person holds a small book labeled "MOYLE WARE" in their left hand. The background features a pattern with an oval frame decorated and topped with a crest with symbols of a bird and stars. Below the portrait, there is a block of text.

artworks.title: Captain Charles Saltonstall
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the viewer's right. He has shoulder-length, curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is dressed in a detailed doublet with a wide collar featuring lacework. A sash drapes diagonally over his body, and he holds a sword in front of him. The background consists of engraved lines, with an inscription surrounding the portrait. Additionally, there is a small heraldic shield and a depiction of a globe at the corners of the engraving.

artworks.title: Thomas Scott, B.D., Political Writer
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man from the bust upwards. He has a serious expression with defined facial features including a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and a short, pointed beard. His hair is short and neat. The man is wearing an elaborate, high-collared garment with a large, ruffled collar typical of the 17th century fashion. The garment has ornate buttons down the front. Around him is an oval frame with text. The background has a simple pattern, and there is text below the portrait.

artworks.title: James Shirley
artworks.description: The image features a man in a seated position within an oval frame of leaves. His face is visible, showing a prominent nose, a small mustache, a goatee, and medium-length wavy hair. He wears a formal robe and has one hand near his chest. Two figures flank him, each holding part of the leafy oval. On the left, a female figure holds a sword and wears a crown and an embellished gown. On the right, another female figure wears a hat and holds a small statue. The background has horizontal lines for texture. Below the portrait is a plaque with text, including the name "W. Marshall sculps" and the year "1640."

artworks.title: James Shirley
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the upper body of a seated man encircled by a laurel wreath. The man has curly hair, a mustache, and a beard. He wears a draped cloak and has a neutral expression. Two allegorical figures flank him: one is a woman with a crown and a sword, and the other is a person in period costume holding a lyre. The background features engraved lines and a Latin inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Josiah Shute, B.D.
artworks.description: The image displays a seated man in an oval frame. The man faces forward, holding a book with hands resting in front of him. He has a round face, a prominent nose, slightly downturned lips, and eyes looking straight at the viewer. He wears a cap, a large collar, and dark robe-like clothing. The background contains textured line work and books with labels like "SCHOLAST" and "PARES." Latin inscriptions surround the portrait, providing information about the subject and the artwork.

artworks.title: Richard Sibbes, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man with a full beard and mustache, wearing a cap and dark gown with a ruffled collar. The background has a cross-hatched design. Text below the image identifies him as Richard Sibbes and mentions his positions at Cambridge and London.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Stapylton, dramatic poet and translator
artworks.description: The image shows a man with an oval face, mustache, pointed beard, shoulder-length wavy hair, and dressed in formal 17th-century attire. He is in an ornate oval frame, holding a scroll and a quill nearby. The background features a draped textile. Above him is a coat of arms, and below is a detailed inscription, with decorative elements on the sides: a satyr-like figure playing an instrument on the left and a classical figure with a book and globe on the right.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Stapylton
artworks.description: The engraving shows a man seated, with facial hair, wearing formal attire. He is sitting at a table with documents, an inkwell, and a quill. The setting includes ornate ornamentation, with a shield above him and decorative scrollwork. Flanking the portrait are mythical creatures and bordering figures. The image is enclosed by a detailed frame with classical and mythological motifs.

artworks.title: John Sym, Rector of Leigh and Essex
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man shown from the waist up, seated and facing forward. He has a serious expression, short beard, mustache, and combed-back hair with a decorative headband. He wears a dark robe with an intricate ruff around his neck. In his left hand, he holds a closed book, and in his right hand, an object resembling spectacles. He wears a bracelet on his wrist. The background features elaborate scrolling patterns and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Thomas Taylor, D.D.
artworks.description: The image features an upper-body engraving of a man seated with his torso facing partly to the right. His face is turned forward towards the viewer. The man has a beard and a mustache, with short, combed hair under a cap that has a detailed pattern towards the top. He is dressed in a formal robe with an ornate ruffled collar and a fur-lined cape draped over his shoulders. One hand is holding a quill, while the other rests on an open book. The background includes an oval frame with inscriptions, likely in Latin, surrounding the man's portrait. The area outside the frame is filled with crosshatched lines, contributing to the image's textured, vintage style.

artworks.title: Thomas Taylor, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to the right, with a serious expression, angular face, pointed beard, and mustache. He has short, receding hair and wears a cap with a complex pattern. He is dressed in a dark robe with a pleated white collar, and a decorative stole is draped over his shoulders. He holds a quill pen above an open book or notebook. The background has textured lines and patterns, with a Latin inscription encircling the portrait.

artworks.title: John Thompson
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with his upper body depicted. He is positioned with his body slightly angled but facing forward, and his head turned towards the viewer, with his right hand pointing to the center of his chest. The man's facial features include a prominent mustache and beard, with long, wavy hair cascading to his shoulders. He is dressed in a richly detailed garment featuring a wide, lace-trimmed collar and a coat adorned with rows of buttons. He wears a decorative piece at his neck. The background includes a scene with several ships at sea and a coastal environment. The portrait is framed with elaborate scrollwork.

artworks.title: John Thompson, Navigator
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in a detailed illustration. He is shown in a half-length pose, facing forward with slight body turn. The man has long, wavy hair, a mustache, and a small goatee. His facial features are finely detailed with a composed expression. He wears a period doublet with decorative fastenings and a large lace collar, with a medallion around his neck. One hand gestures in front of his chest, while the other is hidden. The background shows ships at sea and figures on the shore. The frame surrounding the man and scene features swirling designs and an astrolabe motif at the top.

artworks.title: James Ussher, Archbishop of Armagh
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table, with the upper half of his body visible. He is depicted in a frontal position, with his head turned slightly to his right as he gazes forward. The man has a mature face with distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. His hair is short, gray and neatly combed back, partially covered by a cap. He wears academic or clerical attire, consisting of a dark robe with a voluminous ruff collar. His sleeves are visible with intricate detailing around the cuffs. In his right hand, he holds a quill pen above an open book on the table in front of him. Beside the book, an inkpot and small containers are arranged. In the background, there is a curtain on the right side, and a coat of arms is visible in the top left corner of the print. The bottom of the image includes writing presenting the name and titles of the depicted individual.

artworks.title: James Ussher, Archbishop of Armagh
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing a man depicted from the waist up, sitting upright behind a table. The man has an aged face with a prominent nose, focused eyes, a white beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a cap on his head and a ruff collar around his neck. His attire includes a dark robe with broad sleeves. He has one hand resting on an open book and is pointing to a line on the page with his other hand. The background features columns, drapery, and an emblem in the top left corner. The image appears to be an engraving or etching, given its detailed line work and shading.
